_comment: Copy this to your project's .claude/appium/capabilities.json and fill in the app's ids. The Appium MCP server reads it via CAPABILITIES_CONFIG=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/appium/capabilities.json. Attaches to the INSTALLED app (no apk/ipa path); device selection is dynamic via the select_device / prepare_ios_simulator tools. A missing file is tolerated (the server boots without defaults).
